metadata.description: Development workflow plugins by Subverting Complexity: one for GitHub-backed work, one for work that stays on your machine.

plugins.name: github-workflow
plugins.description: Takes a GitHub story end to end: picks it off the backlog, plans, builds, runs the quality gate, opens a pull request, has that pull request reviewed by agents in a fresh context, and merges it where auto-merge is enabled.

plugins.name: local-workflow
plugins.description: Plans, writes, verifies and commits a task on your machine. No issue tracker and no pull request, plus architecture design and audit, feature discovery, debugging, security audit and documentation.
